verdict.rationale: mParticle documents client SDKs, a first-event guide, and a path to send events directly to the platform (server-side), plus IDSync for identifying users. Community posts confirm app event collection ('Segment.com for mobile apps', app traffic sent to mParticle and forwarded on). Most of the docs evidence is page titles only, so specific SDK platforms and the tracking-spec methods cannot be verified. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of separate web, mobile, and server SDKs, a documented tracking spec defining track/identify/page-style calls, and in-depth SDK documentation content.
